data.summary: All figures match NVIDIA's reported FY2025/FY2024 results: revenue $130.5B vs $60.9B (+114.2%), gross profit $97.9B vs $44.3B (75.0% margin), operating income $81.5B vs $33.0B (62.4% margin), net income $72.9B vs $29.8B (+144.9%), diluted EPS $2.94 vs $1.19 (split-adjusted), R&D $12.9B vs $8.7B. The operating-leverage conclusion is supported.
